# Cyberware medicine
## Diagnosis
1. Place the patient on an operating table connected to [color=#58e6d9]computerBodyScanner[/color]. 2. Open the console and select the Cyberware tab. 3. Read the host slot, integrity, function, power, heat, EMP state and neural connection.
The table is required only for the scanner console. It is not required to perform surgery.
## Internal modules
- Neural link Mk.1: item [color=#58e6d9]NCImplantNeuralLinkMk1[/color], Head, neural-core slot. - Circulatory assist pump Mk.1: item [color=#58e6d9]NCImplantCirculatoryAssistMk1[/color], Chest, thoracic-support slot.
### Installation
1. Select the module's host zone on the target doll. 2. Hold the physical module and click it on the patient. A confirmation popup means it is staged. 3. Open the surgical field, incise and retract until the compatible host structure appears. 4. Hold the multitool, select Cyberware, and apply it inside the host structure. 5. Control bleeding, irrigate and suture the incision. 6. Confirm the installed module in the scanner.
### Repair
Cyberware repair, cooling and power service use the physical service item compatible with the module profile. The surgical Cyberware mode is not a repair shortcut.
### Removal
1. Select the module's host zone. 2. Open a local incision to the module depth. The installed module appears in the operative field only after it is exposed. 3. With no new module staged, hold the multitool, select Cyberware, and apply it directly to the module rectangle. 4. The removed module becomes a physical item in a free hand or beside the patient. 5. Control bleeding, irrigate, close and scan again.
## Mechanical replacements
- Industrial cyberarm: [color=#58e6d9]NCOrganHumanCyberArmLeft[/color] or [color=#58e6d9]NCOrganHumanCyberArmRight[/color]. - Cyberoptics Mk.1: [color=#58e6d9]NCOrganHumanCyberEyes[/color]. - Cyberheart Mk.1: [color=#58e6d9]NCOrganHumanCyberHeart[/color].
### Replacement procedure
1. Select and surgically separate the damaged organic part. 2. Select the now-missing zone. 3. Hold the matching prosthesis and click it on the patient to stage it. 4. Prepare the receiving site and apply Transplant anastomosis with the suture. 5. Repair vessels and nerves as required, close, then scan.
The installed replacement becomes part of the live organ graph. Side and category must match; a left cyberarm cannot replace a right arm.
## Service
- Cyberware coolant agent reduces heat in compatible modules that have a cooling deficit. - Surgical service restores only the integrity and function allowed by the module profile. - Mechanical trauma damages cyberware without creating an organic wound in the module. - EMP temporarily disables a module and can damage its neural interface.
